new.title: Add Expense
new.differentCurrencyNote: This expense is in {expenseCurrency}, but the group uses {groupCurrency}. The amount will be auto-converted.
new.autoRateNote: Exchange rate will be fetched automatically when you save.
new.locationPlaceholder: Search a place, e.g. restaurant or hotel
new.locationUnavailable: This device does not support location.
new.nearbyFailed: Nearby search failed. Allow location or try again later.
new.privateHint: Only you see title and amount. Only possible when the expense is not shared with anyone.
new.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Wi-Fi password, door code, check-in time
new.locationLinkHint: Not found? Paste a Google Maps link or coordinates.

edit.title: Edit Expense
edit.itemSplitWarning: This expense was created from a receipt scan (ITEM split). Editing will convert it to a standard split mode.
edit.formerMemberSharesWarning: This expense includes shares for former group members. Their portion has been reassigned to the payer — review the split before saving.

detail.notFoundDescription: This expense doesn't exist or has been deleted.
detail.privateExpenseHint: Title and amount are only visible to the person who paid.
detail.itemsHint: Read only. Use Edit to change the assignment.

correction.title: AI receipt correction
correction.description: Describe a correction. Your receipt stays unchanged until you confirm.
correction.review: Compare the original with the proposed extraction before applying.
correction.resetWarning: Applying replaces all items and clears assignments, overrides and exchange-rate previews. Printed alternate totals are cleared; review currency conversion again.
correction.failed: Preview failed. Your receipt is unchanged. Try again.
correction.stale: Cannot apply this preview. Discard it and request a new preview; the receipt may have changed.

scan.title: Scan Receipt
scan.uploadDescription: Take a photo or upload an image of your receipt. AI will extract the items, tax, and tip so you can assign them to group members.
scan.rescanDescription: Describe what needs to be corrected and AI will re-scan the receipt.
scan.rescanPlaceholder: e.g., "The total should be $45.99, not $54.99" or "There are 3 tacos, not 1"
scan.shareForClaiming: Share Link — Let Members Claim Items
scan.groupLoadError: Could not load group data. Please try again.
scan.modelHint: If the chosen model fails, the default chain takes over.
scan.startClaimRequest: Ask everyone to pick their items
scan.startClaimRequestHint: Everyone in the group gets a notification and picks their own items, all at the same time.
scan.assignModeTitle: How do you want to assign this receipt?
scan.assignModeSelfHint: Assign the items directly, right here, below.
scan.claimRequestNeedsMembers: Not possible yet: the group needs at least 2 members.
scan.claimRequestBlocked: Not possible right now: finish the AI correction first.
scan.claimRequestNoItems: Not possible: this receipt has no items.
scan.claimRequestSent: Request sent to {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}

receipt.paidTotalHint: Enter what you paid in total, tip included. The tip is calculated for you.
receipt.paidTotalTooLow: Less than items plus tax ({amount}): tip set to 0.
receipt.validationPricePositive: Price must be greater than zero.
receipt.validationQtyPositive: Quantity must be a positive whole number.
receipt.checkGap: Difference of {amount}: compare the lines with the receipt
receipt.changedHint: Changed by hand after the scan, see history
receipt.cardChargeToggle: Paid by card? Enter the amount actually charged
receipt.cardChargeExplain: The receipt only decides who carries which part. What gets shared is the amount that actually left the account (with the bank’s rate and fees).
receipt.cardChargeShared: The charged {amount} is shared in the proportions of the receipt.
receipt.claimNone: Waiting for the group: nobody has picked anything yet.
receipt.claimStatus: {people, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} picked {items} of {total} items.

claim.title: Pick your items
claim.intro: Tap everything you had from “{merchant}”. If you shared something, both of you tap it.
claim.introBy: {name} scanned “{merchant}”. Tap everything you had; if you shared something, both of you tap it.
claim.booked: This receipt has already been booked.
claim.unclaimed: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} nobody has picked yet
claim.shareHint: Includes your part of tax and tip. The amount is final once the receipt is booked.
claim.allPickedBanner: Every item is picked 🎉 The receipt can be booked.
claim.todoAsk: {name} asks you to pick your items of “{title}”
claim.todoOpen: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} still open
claim.todoAllPicked: Everything is picked, ready to book
